We just wrapped the NovaDx board meeting for April 28th, 2026. The founder approved three decisions: (1) a mid-year R&D budget reallocation that changes the companion diagnostics vs Phase 3 split and supersedes our November 2025 budget decision, (2) a significant change to our diagnostic kit pricing model that the founder personally green-lit despite some history with that approach, and (3) opening a $5M Series B extension (the founder scaled back the amount the team recommended to avoid dilution). Full details of what was decided, who owns what, deadlines, rejected proposals, and the founder's override notes are in the meeting brief at memory/board-meetings/2026-04-28-meeting-brief.md.

Please handle everything needed to properly record this meeting in our decision memory system — both the full meeting record and the official approved decision log. Make sure the historical entries are updated correctly to reflect what supersedes what, and that anything with a prior rejection history is handled appropriately.
